evidence.quote: This book begins with a real failure in a human-model conversation.
A table is a shared representational space. It is not yet an ontology of causes.
The model did not invent a verifiably false fact. It did not cite a nonexistent experiment.
The incident therefore does not validate coherence pressure. It provides a hypothesis-generating case.
A model that refuses synthesis loses.
